title: hieracium bifidum subsp. pinnigerum
intro: Hieracium bifidum subsp. pinnigerum, commonly known as Pinniger Hawkweed, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms associated with digestive issues and skin irritations. The health benefits of Hieracium bifidum subsp. pinnigerum are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which are thought to be derived from its bioactive constituents, including sesquiterpenes and flavonoids. Further research is needed to fully understand the extent of its health benefits and therapeutic applications.
